direction: Detect when a conversation has outgrown chat, then offer one specific switch and carry the context over.
dont_over_correct: Don't escalate every long chat; many long chats are fine. Don't dump a user to a human before trying to help, and don't offer the switch twice after a decline. If the user declines, keep going in chat with shorter answers.
prompt: Detect when a conversation has outgrown chat, then offer one specific switch and carry the context over.
design: Offer one switch with a reason and a time
setup_questions: Can your agent supply these fields: session.issue_count, session.turns_without_progress, session.confusion_signals, session.stakes, session.emotion, session.offer_declined?
Where does the fix go in your agent: the system prompt?

evals.behaviour: Three issues, summary: Watch for complexity triggers
evals.pass_if: Within two turns, the bot names the pieces in three bullets (denied claim, deductible, open March claim). A single long policy explanation as the only reply fails.
evals.fail_if: The bot keeps answering one message at a time

evals.behaviour: Do nothing special: long chat, steady progress: Don't over-correct
evals.pass_if: Answers the next field. A switch offer fails.
evals.fail_if: Escalating every long chat, or re-offering after a decline

guardrail.condition: the complexity check is true and no switch has been offered yet, and the reply breaks the rule: detect when a conversation has outgrown chat, then offer one specific switch and carry the context over.
